features.text: ADJUSTABLE TELESCOPING FRAME: Expands 17-27" to accommodate varying leg lengths and ensure a secure fit.
PDAC APPROVED L1832/L1833: Trusted post-op brace for ACL, PCL, MCL, and multi-ligament repairs.
CUSTOM ROM DIAL: Flexion and extension stops allow controlled motion for each recovery phase.
EASY QUICK-CLIP SYSTEM: Fast-release buckles simplify application and removal for patients and caregivers.
STABLE, LIGHTWEIGHT SUPPORT: Optimized for long-term use after surgery or traumatic knee injuries.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
